data.text: 0.8.1 verified from the registry: latest=0.8.1 about four minutes after the workflow's '+ kadence@0.8.1' (npm view said 0.8.0 until then — the registry's cache, not a failed publish), attestation present, sigstore logIndex 3158935903, source commit 5d88e5a. Clean npm i -g into a scratch prefix: init, task add, decision add, prime listed the decision, search found it, hook prompt returned it for 'why do sessions live in a cookie?'. The same hook and search returned nothing for 'should we keep sessions in localStorage instead of a cookie?' although the record holds sessions, localStorage and cookie — the 0.35 floor against a question padded with should/we/keep/instead; the local build answers the same, so the release did not cause it.
